answer_1.quote: We evaluate the state-of-the-art models and observe significant improvement in the emotional support provided when various support strategies are utilized.
answer_1.outputs: Generated emotional support responses in dialogues

answer_2.quote: The automatic metrics we adopted include perplexity (PPL), BLEU-2 (B-2), ROUGE-L (R-L), and the BOW Embedding-based Extrema matching score.

answer_4.quote: We recruited participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk to chat with the models. Participants were asked to compare the two models based on the following questions: (1) Fluency: which bot's responses were more fluent and understandable? (2) Identification: which bot explored your situation more in depth and was more helpful in identifying your problems? (3) Comforting: which bot was more skillful in comforting you? (4) Suggestion: which bot gave you more helpful suggestions for your problems? (5) Overall: generally, which bot's emotional support do you prefer?
answer_4.guideline: Participants compared models pairwise based on predefined questions
